feature_spec.title: RunSystemGate upgrade for QEG/manual-bb verification
acceptance_criteria: RunSystemPacket can be evaluated into gatefield, state-gate, manual-bb, and QEG verdicts
advisory mode records gate evidence without blocking existing transitions
enforce mode blocks applied tool_plan output until acceptance evidence exists
clean results can proceed in enforce mode
4OSS CLI adapters remain explicitly out of scope for this upgrade
assumptions: External 4OSS CLIs are not invoked in this version
RunSystemGate is an internal contract evaluator that keeps adapter inputs stable

observation_set.summary: RunSystemPacket can be evaluated into gatefield/state-gate/QEG/manual-bb outputs.
Enforce mode blocks applied tool_plan outputs that still require acceptance.

risk_register.summary: Advisory and enforce mode are separated by implementation and tests.
Acceptance-required tool_plan output blocks in enforce mode.
External 4OSS CLI adapters are documented as follow-up work, not claimed as complete.

gate_decision.reason: RunSystemGate, enforce/advisory separation, QEG/manual-bb evidence, and 4OSS boundary documentation are implemented for v0.3.0.
